column3: Install consent in the market: install, update and rollback compute the permissions a version needs (code from its declared ingle.plugins permissions, bundles from the compiled plugins their verified rows mount, git as runtime) and reject with consent_required and { permissions: [{ id, title, why }] } when grant and the held permissions leave one out; a consent rejection writes no receipt
column4: the AMA-17 brief asks for install-time consent; held permissions come from the package's mounted rows so an update asks only for what is new; git code cannot be read before the build, so it asks for the strongest permission; a receipt would answer the granted retry with the stale rejection when the client reuses the command id
column5: plugins/market/market.test.ts: a secrets-mounting bundle is refused, stores nothing, is refused again under the same command id, installs with grant, and updates with no new prompt; a code update adding network and secrets asks for both, then for secrets alone after granting network
